title: Catalyst: Ascendance
description: Forge 1.20.1 kitchen sink: Terralith, dungeons, Mekanism to Avaritia, shaders.
body:
# Catalyst: Ascendance

Explore a breathtaking world. Build machines that matter. Break the ceiling with endgame power.

Catalyst: Ascendance is a Forge 1.20.1 kitchen-sink modpack for players who want beautiful exploration, deep automation, and a real endgame payoff. Start in Terralith landscapes and custom dungeons, then grow into Mekanism networks, Mystical Agriculture farms, and the power of Re-Avaritia.

Who is this pack for?

You will enjoy it if you like tech progression, stunning terrain and structure hunting, QoL like JEI, backpacks and waystones, and a strong late game after some grind.

It may not suit you if you want a tiny vanilla plus pack, very low RAM, or hardcore survival without powerful tools.

About 170 mods. Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.

Core gameplay loop

Explore Terralith and Biomes O' Plenty, Alex's Caves and Mobs, YUNG's structures, Awesome Dungeons, Dungeons and Taverns.

Establish a base with Sophisticated Backpacks, Guard Villagers, Waystones, Forestry, Botany Pots.

Automate with Mekanism, Applied Energistics 2, Industrial Foregoing, Pipez, Cyclic.

Scale up with Evolved Mekanism, Mystical Agriculture, tiered Botany Pots, Iron Furnaces.

Ascend with Re-Avaritia, Curios, Artifacts, Rings of Ascension, and a reworked End.

Highlights

World: Terralith, Biomes O' Plenty, Dynamic Trees, Alex's Caves and Mobs, YUNG's suite, Awesome Dungeons, Luminous and Bygone Nether, improved villages.

Tech: full Mekanism, Evolved Mekanism, AE2 with Applied Mekanistics, Industrial Foregoing with Souls, Mystical Agriculture, Forestry, Cyclic.

Endgame: Re-Avaritia, Artifacts, Rings of Ascension, custom End progression.

Visuals: Embeddium, Oculus, Mellow Shader, Sound Physics, EMF and ETF, Camera Overhaul, Legendary Tooltips, Loot Beams.

QoL: JEI and addons, Sophisticated Backpacks, Xaero's maps, inventory sorting, crafting tweaks.

Requirements and install

Allocate 8 to 10 GB RAM. Java 17. A dedicated GPU helps with shaders; they can be disabled on weaker PCs. Performance mods included: Embeddium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling.

Install via Modrinth App or import the mrpack. First launch may take several minutes. Select Mellow Shader in video settings if needed.

Multiplayer supported: use the same pack version on server and client.


Catalyst: Ascendance. The world is the laboratory. Ascension is the result.

For questions and errors, please write to [Telegram](https://t.me/yamato_taira)

# Катализ: Возвышение

Исследуй невероятный мир. Строй фабрики с смыслом. Выйди в настоящий эндгейм.

«Катализ: Возвышение» — kitchen-sink сборка на Forge 1.20.1: красивый мир, глубокая автоматизация и сильная награда за время. Сначала Terralith и данжи, потом Mekanism, Mystical Agriculture и Re-Avaritia.

Для кого эта сборка

Зайдёт, если нравится техно-прогрессия, красивый мир, QoL и мощный финал после гринда.

Не подойдёт, если нужна маленькая vanilla plus сборка, мало RAM или чистый хардкор без «имбы».

Около 170 модов. Одиночка и мультиплеер.

Основной цикл

Исследование: Terralith, Biomes O' Plenty, Alex's Caves и Mobs, YUNG's, Awesome Dungeons, Dungeons and Taverns.

База: Sophisticated Backpacks, Guard Villagers, Waystones, Forestry, Botany Pots.

Автоматизация: Mekanism, AE2, Industrial Foregoing, Pipez, Cyclic.

Масштаб: Evolved Mekanism, Mystical Agriculture, тиры горшков, Iron Furnaces.

Возвышение: Re-Avaritia, Curios, Artifacts, Rings of Ascension, переработанный Энд.

Что внутри

Мир: Terralith, BOP, Dynamic Trees, Alex's Caves и Mobs, YUNG's, Awesome Dungeons, Luminous и Bygone Nether, улучшенные деревни.

Техника: Mekanism, Evolved Mekanism, AE2, Industrial Foregoing с Souls, Mystical Agriculture, Forestry, Cyclic.

Эндгейм: Re-Avaritia, Artifacts, Rings of Ascension, свой путь по Энду.

Картинка: Embeddium, Oculus, Mellow Shader, Sound Physics, EMF и ETF, Camera Overhaul, Legendary Tooltips.

QoL: JEI и дополнения, Sophisticated Backpacks, карты Xaero's, сортировка и твики крафта.

Требования и установка

8–10 ГБ RAM, Java 17. Шейдеры можно отключить на слабом ПК. Есть Embeddium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling.

Установка через Modrinth App или mrpack. Первый запуск долгий. Mellow Shader — в настройках видео через Oculus.

Мультиплеер: одна версия сборки на сервере и у игроков.

Катализ: Возвышение. Мир — лаборатория. Возвышение — результат.

По вопросам и ошибкам писать в [Телеграм](https://t.me/yamato_taira)
